PR Summary by Qodo

Preserve source timestamp provenance in Codex replay and accounting 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Separate source event time, capture time, and timestamp quality without changing all-time token
>  totals.
>• Replay verified rollouts under existing occurrence IDs and exclude unverified time from dated
>  accounting, Intelligence, and forecasts.
>• Add migration and cross-platform regressions for source identity, thread selection, and path
>  sanitization.
>
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Eager full-history provenance rebuild
- ➕ Repairs eligible historical rows before dated queries resume. - ➖ Requires an unbounded migration and risks restamping captures or changing established occurrence identities and amounts.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the PR's bounded, prefix-verified replay. It makes uncertain legacy chronology explicitly unverified immediately, then repairs only provenance that source bytes can establish; an eager rebuild offers faster coverage at substantially greater migration and data-integrity risk.

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (0) 📘 Rule violations (0) 🔗 Cross-repo conflicts (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Linux/macOS refreshes re-hash whole rollouts ✗ Dismissed
>
>Description >
> >
>cachedPrefix now requires sameFile and is turned off for fallback-path: identities. Meanwhile,
>legacyIdentity keeps an upgraded fallback: checkpoint identity forever, so on Linux sameFile
>never becomes true again; on macOS every identity is fallback-path:. In both cases
>HashThroughAsync re-reads the entire consumed prefix on every refresh of every changed file. For
>actively growing session files the I/O keeps rising with file size, which slows the bounded
>16-file-per-pass refresh scheduler.
>
>
>
>Code >
> > >```diff >+ bool cachedPrefix = sameFile && !sourceIdentity.StartsWith("fallback-path:", StringComparison.Ordinal) && >+ existing?.ConsumedPrefixSha256 is { } knownHash && >``` >
>
>Relevance >
> > `●●● Strong` > >
>Accepted identity-handling precedents favor preserving stable checkpoints and avoiding repeated
>full-file work.
>
> > > ⓘ Recommendations generated based on similar findings in past PRs >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>sameFile is true only when the stored identity equals the newly computed one, or starts with it
>plus :generation:. On Linux, GetSourceIdentity now returns linux:..., but a verified legacy
>checkpoint keeps sourceIdentity = existing.SourceIdentity (fallback:...) through
>canResume/metadataOnlyReplay. That identity is saved back to the checkpoint, so later runs
>compare fallback:... against linux:... and sameFile stays false. On macOS the new identity is
>always fallback-path:..., which line 116 excludes outright. With cachedPrefix false, line 124
>calls HashThroughAsync(existing.LastByteOffset) on every ingestion, even though
>_verifiedPrefixes is still filled at the end of each run.
>
> >
2. Backfilled context hides newer events ✓ Resolved
>
>Description >
> >
>GetContextObservationsAsync now orders and limits rows by captured_at_utc instead of verified
>event time. When older session records are imported after newer ones, the Observatory’s 240-row
>context list puts the older events first and can omit the most recent events despite displaying
>their source dates.
>
>
>
>Code >
> > >```diff >+ ORDER BY captured_at_utc DESC, source_event_at_utc DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT $take; >``` >
>
>Relevance >
> > `●●● Strong` > >
>Capture-time ordering conflicts with the PR’s stated source-time chronology and can truncate newer
>visible events.
>
> > ⓘ Recommendations generated based on similar findings in past PRs >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>The changed query applies LIMIT $take after capture-time ordering. The page requests 240 rows and
>displays verified source event times, so a later capture of older events can displace newer
>event-time rows from the visible list.
>
> >
3. Legacy duplicate totals lose their warning ✓ Resolved
>
>Description >
> >
>ReadComparisonsAsync now requires source_timestamp_quality = 'Valid' for its repeated-event
>fingerprint query. Schema migration marks every existing token row LegacyUnverified without
>changing its amounts or observed timestamp, so matching cross-file legacy rows disappear from this
>diagnostic while remaining in the lifetime total.
>
>
>
>Code >
> > >```diff >+ WHERE source_event_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND source_timestamp_quality = 'Valid' >+ GROUP BY session_id,source_event_at_utc,model,reasoning_effort,uncached_input_tokens,cache_read_tokens, >``` >
>
>Relevance >
> > `●● Moderate` > >
>Filtering unverified chronology appears intentional, but its impact on duplicate diagnostics creates
>a genuine observability tradeoff.
>
> > ⓘ Recommendations generated based on similar findings in past PRs >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>The migration defaults old token rows to LegacyUnverified with null source event time. The changed
>fingerprint query excludes them, while the adjacent lifetime comparison still sums all native token
>rows; thus previously visible repeated-event candidates from legacy history are no longer shown.
>
> >
Context sources
✅ Compliance rules (platform): 17 rules
✅ Cross-repo context — repo relationships
Review mode: Auto: 🧠 Deep: Broad provenance, migration, ingestion, accounting, and forecasting changes create many independent defect opportunities.
Tip of the day 
💡 Did you know, you can turn these tips off under Display > Comment parts
More tips ↗ | Customize Qodo ↗ | Qodo docs ↗

1\. Backfilled context hides newer events 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
GetContextObservationsAsync now orders and limits rows by captured_at_utc instead of verified
event time. When older session records are imported after newer ones, the Observatory’s 240-row
context list puts the older events first and can omit the most recent events despite displaying
their source dates.
Dismiss ↗ | View ↗

3\. Legacy duplicate totals lose their warning 🐞 Bug ◔ Observability 
ReadComparisonsAsync now requires source_timestamp_quality = 'Valid' for its repeated-event
fingerprint query. Schema migration marks every existing token row LegacyUnverified without
changing its amounts or observed timestamp, so matching cross-file legacy rows disappear from this
diagnostic while remaining in the lifetime total.
Dismiss ↗ | View ↗
